4:122.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do deeds of righteousness, We shall admit them to the Gardens under which rivers flow
to dwell therein forever. Allâh’s Promise is the Truth; and whose words can be truer than those of Allâh?

4:123.text: It will not be in accordance with your desires
, nor those of the people of the Scripture
, whosoever works evil, will have the recompense thereof, and he will not find any protector or helper besides Allâh.

4:124.text: And whoever does righteous good deeds, male or female, and is a
, such will enter Paradise and not the least injustice, even to the size of a speck on the back of a date-stone, will be done to them.

4:125.text: And who can be better in religion than one who submits his face
(i.e. follows Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism)
. And follows the religion of Ibrâhîm
(Islâmic Monotheism - to worship none but Allâh Alone)

4:126.text: And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And Allâh is Ever Encompassing all things.

4:127.text: They ask your legal instruction concerning women, say: Allâh instructs you about them, and about what is recited unto you in the Book concerning the orphan girls whom you give not the prescribed portions
and yet whom you desire to marry, and
the children who are weak and oppressed, and that you stand firm for justice to orphans. And whatever good you do, Allâh is Ever All-Aware of it.
